name: command-bar-favourite-finds-its-moved-tab
description: Enter on a command bar favourite called OpenOrActivateUrl, whose exact-string match misses once the favourite's tab has navigated - the same mismatch, but for the favourite's own accept rather than the engine one. Reuses the redirecting-favourite fixture: the tile opens and claims a tab, then the page's own meta refresh moves it off the stored url before the command bar ever gets involved, so a fix that only worked for an unmoved favourite would still pass here and prove nothing.

actions.note: first paint, and the sidebar announces itself
ssh-launched Atrium is not frontmost on a clean snapshot
the only favourite tile, at a sibling scenario's own coordinates. This click OPENS and CLAIMS the tab everything below is about.
VACUITY GUARD: without a claimed tab there is nothing for the command bar accept to find by key
long enough for the page to load AND for the meta refresh to commit, which is what moves the tab off the tile's stored url
let the /commandbar document commit and take the field
the autocomplete pass and the favourite row land together
the row on screen really is the favourite's own, by its stored url
the top row's Enter - the favourite row, matching only its stored title
the accept reached BrowserController at all

assertions.desc: Liveness, and a guard against a click landing somewhere that spawned a window.
VACUITY GUARD: the row Enter is about to accept carries the favourite's stored url, not something the query merely matched by chance
THE POSITIVE HALF: Enter on the favourite row reached AcceptCommandBarFavorite

assertions.pattern: Atrium: favourite activated the tab it opened, by key
assertions.desc: THE ASSERTION: found by the marker the claim left, not by a url string the moved tab no longer carries - this line only fires through ActivateFavoriteRow, which OpenOrActivateUrl never calls
at most the tile's own first open - before the fix the accept opened a second copy here, because the moved tab's exact url matched nothing
the floor beside that ceiling: the tile's own open still happened, so the ceiling above is not passing on a run that opened nothing at all
